The Li-ion battery recycling market is projected to grow from $12.2 billion in 2025 to $18.1 billion by 2030. 

To find the growth, we need to subtract the initial amount from the final amount: $18.1 billion - $12.2 billion = $5.9 billion 

So the market is projected to grow by $5.9 billion.

The annual growth rate can be found using the formula: ((final amount - initial amount) / initial amount) / number of years
= ($5.9 billion / $12.2 billion) / 5
= 0.483 or 48.3%

The compound annual growth rate is 8.2% (from the text), but that is the rate from 2025 to 2030.
